subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: What current-main evidence is sufficient before authorizing an iOS reconciliation repair: the reporter's release logs alone, or an exact deterministic native replay of overlapping post-tool history responses?
rationale: Current main already contains adjacent reconciliation guards, so selecting a code change without proving which remaining ordering path fails risks duplicating policy or regressing the recently merged provisional-final behavior.

options.title: Require exact native replay
options.body: Obtain the offered screenshots and request timing, encode the delayed out-of-order tool-run sequence in the shared replay harness, and repair only the demonstrated failing transition.

options.title: Start owner-led source investigation
options.body: Allow an iOS owner to trace and instrument every history trigger now, accepting that the first change may be diagnostic rather than a final fix.

recommendation.title: Require exact native replay
recommendation.body: Obtain the offered screenshots and request timing, encode the delayed out-of-order tool-run sequence in the shared replay harness, and repair only the demonstrated failing transition.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a native iOS transcript-integrity decision, and repository ownership guidance plus the issue timeline route that surface to this owner.
